selected_policy: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
missing_information: The submitted records are primarily focused on a cervical spine condition and procedure (C5-C6), while the requested procedure is a lumbar spine procedure (C5-C6). The policy requires the procedure to be medically necessary for the specified lumbar condition.
The MRI report does not explicitly mention dynamic instability or Meyerding Grade II+ listhesis, which are required imaging findings for actual instability and recurrent disc herniation criteria.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: The individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608: Lumbar Decompression.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Patient has failed conservative management (8 weeks PT with no meaningful improvement) and presents with significant symptoms (pain, numbness, functional disability) consistent with a need for surgery. Physician note confirms failure of conservative management.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis with EITHER of the following: dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image, with a difference in translational alignment between vertebrae >3mm between views
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing causing severe neural compression. The report does not explicitly state dynamic instability or Meyerding Grade II+ listhesis.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state Meyerding Grade II+ listhesis.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis (e.g., Isthmic Spondylolisthesis) with ANY of the following: Meyerding Grade I or II spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) and plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis or Meyerding Grade I/II listhesis.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: Meyerding Grade III or higher spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) with ≥50% anterior slippage OR plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state Meyerding Grade III+ listhesis or ≥50% anterior slippage.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: progressive spinal pain without confirmatory imaging showing progression of spondylolisthesis
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state progressive spinal pain.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: multi-level spondylolysis on plain x-rays
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state multi-level spondylolysis.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: post-operative instability created by the disruption of the posterior elements due to facet joint excision that exceeding 50% bilaterally or 75% or more of a single facet
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state post-operative instability.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: pars fracture
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state pars fracture.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Imaging findings include ANY of the following: previous spinal decompression that resulted in iatrogenic spondylolisthesis
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI report shows C5-C6 disc extrusion with foraminal narrowing. The report does not explicitly state previous spinal decompression resulting in iatrogenic spondylolisthesis.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER of the following: individual is a never-smoker
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Urine cotinine screen result is Negative.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER of the following: individual has refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/ or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Urine cotinine screen result is Negative.
